sentences.text: THE HONOURABLE SMT. JUSTICE P.V.ASHA  Tuesday, the 2nd day of March 2021/11th Phalguna, 1942

For information purpose only PETITIONER:
 INDIRA, AGED 64 YEARS,
 D/O.SUKUMARAN, PROPRIETRIX,
 N.N.OIL INDUSTRIES, RAVI VARMA LANE,
 ATTINGAL, THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695101.
RESPONDENTS:
1. THE COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY,
 THYCAUD P.O., THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695014.
2.

THE JOINT COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY,
 (ADMINISTRATION, LEGAL AND VIGILANCE),
 THYCAUD P.O., THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695014.
3. THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF FOOD SAFETY,
 VANCHIYOOR P.O., THIRUVANANTHAPURAM-695035.
 Writ Petition (civil) praying inter alia that in the circumstances stated in the affidavit filed along with the WP(C) the High Court be pleased to stay all further proceedings pursuant to Exhibit P4 order of the 1st respondent, pending disposal of the writ petition.
 This petition coming on for admission upon perusing the petition and the affidavit filed in support of WP(C) and upon hearing the arguments of M/S.R.SUDHISH, MUSTHAFA V.M & M.MANJU, Advocates for the petitioner and of GOVERNMENT PLEADER for Respondents, the court passed the following:
 P.T.O.
Indira vs The Commissioner Of Food Safety on 2 March, 2021 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132929313/
1  WP(C) 5376/2021 2/2  ORDER Admit.
The learned Government Pleader takes notice for respondents.

sentences.text:
In view of the orders passed in similar cases, there shall be a direction to the respondents to For information purpose only allow the Petitioner to continue the manufacturing & sale of "EMPEROR COCONUT OIL", "MALABAR KERA AGMARK COCONUT OIL", "KALPA KERA AGMARK COCONUT OIL" & "RAJA COCONUT OIL"
on the basis of Ext.P1 license as well as Ext.P3 registration.
ASSISTANT REGISTRAR EXHIBIT P1 - COPY OF THE RENEWAL OF LICENSE FOR THE PERIOD 20.6.2019 TO 19.6.2024 ISSUED TO THE PETITIONER UNDER THE FOOD SAFETY AND STANDARDS ACT 2006 DATED 29.6.2019.
EXHIBIT P3 - COPY OF THE REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE UNDER GST RULE DATED 16.7.2018.
EXHIBIT P4 - COPY OF THE ORDER NO.G-7721/18/CFS OF THE 2ND RESPONDENT DATED 05.02.2020.
